title: LOLv2 random30 historical result
content: Historical LOLv2 30-image validation reported Agent success 30/30, rollback success 3/3, AI adopted 96.67%, V2 rescored score 82.1914 vs fixed Retinexformer LOL-v2-real 80.7928, PSNR 24.4673 vs 22.9311, and SSIM 0.9501 vs 0.9312. Re-run evaluation before citing final paper numbers.

title: HVI-CIDNet SICE TensorRT historical result
content: HVI-CIDNet/SICE was the first verified TensorRT target. Historical FP32 speed observations: 256x256 PyTorch 25.83 ms vs TensorRT 19.72 ms, 512x512 PyTorch 91.13 ms vs TensorRT 32.97 ms, 768x768 PyTorch 362.43 ms vs TensorRT 79.36 ms.
